name: dotnet-msix

MSIX: create, sign, submit to Store, sideload, auto-update, bundle, CI/CD. Assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+, Windows 10 build 19041+ (MSIX); build 1709+ (App Installer auto-update); .NET 8.0+.

WinUI 3 packages from `.csproj` with `<WindowsPackageType>MSIX</WindowsPackageType>`; WPF/WinForms use Visual Studio “Windows Application Packaging Project” (`.wapproj`). See [skill:dotnet-winui], [skill:dotnet-native-aot], [skill:dotnet-gha-patterns], [skill:dotnet-ado-patterns], [skill:dotnet-nuget-authoring], [skill:dotnet-containers].

Build:
dotnet publish --configuration Release --runtime win-x64 \

All MSIX packages must be signed to install on Windows. The signing certificate's Subject must match the `Publisher` attribute in the package manifest.

Development certificate:
$cert = New-SelfSignedCertificate `
-Subject "CN=My Company, O=My Company, L=Seattle, S=WA, C=US" `
-FriendlyName "MyApp Dev Signing" `
-CertStoreLocation "Cert:\CurrentUser\My" `
-TextExtension @("<REDACTED_IP>={text}<REDACTED_IP>.<REDACTED_IP>.3", `
"<REDACTED_IP>={text}")
$password = ConvertTo-SecureString -String "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" -Force -AsPlainText
Export-PfxCertificate -Cert $cert `
-FilePath "MyApp_DevSigning.pfx" `
$signtool = Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\*\x64\signtool.exe" |
Sort-Object { [version]($_.Directory.Parent.Name) } -Descending |
Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
& $signtool sign /fd SHA256 /a /f "MyApp_DevSigning.pfx" `
/p "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" `
"AppPackages\MyApp_1.0.0.0_x64.msix"
